title: PLAYER 2 GETS THE RUN OVER CARD TOO
why: His order of 2026-10-18: there seem to be a lot of inconsistencies between p1 and p2 games, please coordinate them better. The host built the RUN OVER card (team score, a row each, EXTRACTED x2 or KIA -50%, the best moments) at the end of a run and player 2 only tore its raid down, so at the end of every run one TV showed the result and the other showed the attract. Player 2 now builds the same card from its own score and the host score it was sent, after the doubling or the halving has been applied to both. Nothing is saved or sent from it: the board row, the music and the initials stay the host job.
now: At the end of a party arcade run the player 2 window now shows the same Run over card as player 1, with the team score and a row for each player.
